_comment: CI Monitor configuration. Each value is a regex; absent keys fall back to in-code defaults (see README.md). artifact_name_regex selects which run artifacts carry test-result markers worth downloading. test_marker_regex locates the per-test ndjson marker. ignored_check_regex matches check-run names left out of the verdict; they still appear in the summary, marked [ignored].
_comment_test_marker: This repo matches BOTH ##GB4PC_TEST## and ##TEST## for back-compatibility while the emit side still writes ##GB4PC_TEST##. The JSON payload begins at the end of whichever alternative matched, so both markers parse correctly. Alternation order does not matter for this pair (neither marker is a prefix of the other); the full marker is simply listed first as a readable convention.
_comment_ignored: Administrative merge holds (not failure) is the merge gate, which agents/dev_orchestration.md leaves off the checks that count. ignored_check_regex escapes the parentheses in that name, since its value is a regex.
